description: Answers a link where the user types the Companies House codes a filing needs, so the codes never appear in the chat. Answers {entryId, url, expiresAt}: show the user the url, wait for them to say they have saved the codes, then pass entryId as codesEntryId to the filing tool. The link works for ten minutes. A single entry is used up by one filing call; ask again for a second filing. To file for several practice clients through run_for_clients, give clientIds (kind accounts or confirmation-statement-data, no companyNumber): the page then asks for one company authentication code per client by name, and each client's filing call takes only its own client's codes, so the one entryId serves the whole batch. kind accounts is for submit_micro_entity_accounts_sandbox and submit_small_company_accounts_sandbox, confirmation-statement-data for get_confirmation_statement_data_sandbox, and confirmation-statement (with directors, in the order the filing lists them) for submit_confirmation_statement_sandbox. Over the deployed API.

clientIds.description: Practice client ids for a batch filing through run_for_clients: the page asks for one code per client

companyNumber.description: The 8-character Companies House company number; required unless clientIds is given

directors.description: Confirmation statement only: the directors in filing order; the page asks for one personal code each

kind.description: Which filing the codes are for

name: request_companies_house_codes
title: Request Companies House codes
